description: Fail a project whose call stacks broke the depth or breadth limits it is held to, resolved against the project and its Nx dependencies.

configurationPath.description: Path to the callidescope configuration file, relative to the workspace root.

projects.description: Nx project names to gate, replacing the project this target belongs to.

tags.description: Nx project tags to gate, selecting every project carrying ANY of them.

withDependencies.description: Widen the selection along the Nx dependency graph, so a call stack is not truncated at a project boundary.
